arabic_html:
وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ
وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ
إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ ۞
translation: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is generally most unjust and ungrateful.
explanation_html: Maʿārif-ul-Qurʾān: we never asked for existence itself — no one raised their hands begging for the sky, the earth, the sun. It was given before the asking, and it cannot be counted.
